customManagers.description: Track Savvy appVersion in Helm Chart.yaml

packageRules.description: Savvy image: disable digest pinning, auto-merge version updates after CI
Savvy image: disable Renovate for dev overlay (uses rolling 'dev' tag)
cookie: pin to v1.x — SvelteKit imports parse/serialize, removed in cookie v2 (ESM-only). Override floor stays for GHSA bounds-bypass fix.

typescript: cap below 6.1 — @typescript-eslint/* declares typescript as a required peer at >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so npm ci fails with ERESOLVE above that; svelte-check and @sveltejs/kit cap at ^6. Lift once typescript-eslint widens its TypeScript peer range.
